answer.origin: Yahoo Finance, published 2026-07-01, reporting an NN, Inc. announcement said to have occurred in late June 2026. The announcement’s exact date and an underlying original release are not supplied.
answer.note: The report says NN plans to add 47 machine centers at its Wuxi plant for liquid cooling production for NVIDIA AI data-center racks (incoming). It also reports NN’s statement that 100% of this new capacity was already pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards (item:e2), and that NN targeted US$80–US$90 million of accretive new business in 2026 from the expansion (item:e3). This is a relevant potential supply-capacity and ecosystem-demand signal for NVDA: it suggests planned capacity associated with cooling for NVIDIA racks has been allocated. However, the report does not identify the award customers or establish that NVIDIA is the buyer, contracting party, or source of the reported target. All the reported facts could be true if an intermediary or another customer bought the capacity, so a direct NVIDIA order or revenue implication remains a hypothesis. The US$80–US$90 million figure is NN’s target, not NVIDIA spending or revenue.
limitations: The pre-sold capacity’s customer identities and allocation are not disclosed, so the extent of any direct NVIDIA commercial relationship is unknown.
The report gives no contract values, delivery or ramp schedule, or revenue-recognition timing, limiting conclusions about when or how much capacity becomes available.
The exact date of NN’s announcement and the underlying announcement text are not provided.
follow_up: Check NN’s original late-June 2026 announcement and subsequent filings for the award customers, whether NVIDIA is a direct customer or the capacity serves its racks through another party, and any disclosed award terms.

Check later NN disclosures for installation, qualification, ramp, and realized revenue from the 47 machine centers; treat any disclosed NN revenue as supplier evidence, not as NVDA orders without a stated link.
Look for NVIDIA disclosures or other corroboration identifying NN or the relevant cooling supplier and confirming the commercial relationship.
